title: Hebe
author: Marina Diagourta
description: Your anniversary celebration takes a dark turn when the Titan Kronos strikes Mount Olympus, threatening the very existence of the Olympian gods! Embark on a journey through ancient Greece, where you'll solve puzzles, rescue your divine family, and confront the mighty Titan. Can you restore balance and seal the Titans back in Tartaros once and for all? The fate of Olympus rests in your hands!
